== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ホス：エコー通路</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light Side''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、各ターンに１回、フォース４を使用して転換されたホスの位置カードを一番上に戻すことができる。</span>

'''Dark Side''' — <span lang="ja"></span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Hoth: Echo Corridor]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. If you control this site, once per turn you may use 4 Force to return a converted Hoth location card to the top. Dark Side. The printed game-text box is blank.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Dark Side box is blank on both faces. Japanese uses 位置カード where English says site.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-hothechocorridor.gif|Original English face]], [[Hoth: Echo Corridor]].</ref>
